summary: Use open GPU simulators to investigate architecture hypotheses while distinguishing modeled behavior from real-device evidence.
outcomes: Explain functional versus timing simulation and trace-driven limits.
Validate a simulator configuration before comparing design changes.
sequence: State a concrete cache or scheduler hypothesis.
Map workload instructions and memory behavior to model inputs.
Establish a baseline and compare against available hardware observations.
Change one modeled resource and inspect sensitivity.
Report model assumptions, error and external-validity limits.

visual.question: Does the apparent improvement survive model error and workload changes?
visual.interaction: Change one modeled parameter and compare several workloads.

practice.task: Run or analyze a reproducible architecture sensitivity study.
practice.success: Report separates simulation results from measurements and includes calibration/error evidence.
